**Introduction**

I'm Vijay, also known as cryptotura. I have been contributing to Dash Core since 2021, primarily focusing on backporting changes from Bitcoin to Dash.

Over the years, I have successfully merged numerous pull requests into Dash Core, contributing to the project's stability, feature parity, and overall improvement. My work has been integral in ensuring Dash benefits from the latest advancements in Bitcoin's codebase while maintaining Dash's unique features and requirements.

**What do I do?**

My primary role has been as a C++ Software Engineer specializing in Bitcoin backporting for Dash. This involves adapting Bitcoin's updates to Dash, addressing customisation specific to Dash code base.

**What have I done, specifically?**

Dear Dash Community,

I’m reaching out to humbly ask for your support in the final days of voting for my proposal, [Funding Vijay for Bitcoin Backporting](https://www.dashcentral.org/p/BTCBackportsVijay_01).

Unfortunately, my proposal didn’t pass last cycle due to budget constraints. However, I remain hopeful that with your help, we can secure the votes needed to move forward.

I fully understand how important it is to ask for your support, and I don’t take it lightly. Let me explain why your vote matters:

Over the past months, I have been dedicated to backporting Bitcoin updates to Dash to keep our codebase aligned with critical Bitcoin Core enhancements and security fixes. Some of my recent work includes:
  • Improvements to memory safety, transaction processing, and RPC documentation.
  • Enhancements in error handling and overall system stability
Below is list of my most recent contribution
  1. PR Link Updates and Improvements Backported​
  2. PR #6257 Added references for Bech32(m) generator and constants, dropped Leak Sanitizer suppressions​
  3. PR #5884 Various refactors and bug fixes for stability​
  4. PR #6064 Updated RPC command documentation for clarity​
  5. PR #6061 Enhanced error handling for RPC errors​
  6. PR #6071 Updates to documentation and minor bug fixes​
  7. PR #6129 Fixes for memory handling and optimization​
  8. PR #6130 Improvements to handling of core node settings​
  9. PR #6133 Bug fixes for handling invalid transactions​
  10. PR #6134 Refactoring to enhance code clarity and reduce code complexity​
  11. PR #6220 Added missing RPC examples and enhanced documentation​
  12. PR #6250 Prevented wallet code from interfering with node settings​
  13. PR #6256 Fixed issues with the -persistmempool option and added necessary documentation​
  14. PR #6264 Corrected C++ argument names and updated RPC handling​
  15. PR #6263 Prevented potential memory exhaustion issues and enhanced fuzz testing stability​
  16. PR #6274 Fixed bug in estimatesmartfee RPC and refactored unnecessary code​
  17. PR #6305 Added additional validation and improved transaction safety checks​
  18. PR #6309 Minor bug fixes and improvements in error handling​
  19. PR #6435 Various improvements to the network and protocol layer​

You can explore a detailed list of my contributions [here](https://github.com/pulls?q=is%3Apr+author%3Avijaydasmp+archived%3Afalse+sort%3Aupdated-desc+is%3Aclosed+is%3Amerged).

The success of this proposal is critical to the ongoing backporting work I am doing, and your vote in the next few days could make all the difference. If you see the value this work brings, I would be incredibly grateful for your support.

Thank you to those who have already backed this proposal—your support has been a great motivator. If you have any questions or concerns, please don’t hesitate to reach out.

Since the last funding 22 Jan, the following pull requests have been merged into the Dash repository:

**PR #6308** – Merged on Feb 4: Backports Bitcoin PRs #23712 and #23346 to improve wallet CLI test robustness and refactor headers in the `bitcoin-wallet` tool.

**PR #6534** – Merged on Feb 11: Backports Bitcoin PRs #25427 and #25428 to optimize wallet performance by removing redundant transaction lookups and simplify socket handling by removing obsolete functions.

**PR #6519** – Merged on Feb 17: Backports Bitcoin PRs #23418, #25480, and #25492 to fix signed integer overflow in the `prioritisetransaction` RPC, replace `CountSecondsDouble` with `Ticks&lt;SecondsDouble&gt;`, and clean up MSVC-specific warning pragmas.

**PR #6550** – Merged on Feb 18: Backports Bitcoin PRs #25784, #25878, #25865, and #25879 to improve wallet flag documentation, use mocktime for wallet encryption timeout tests, speed up wallet tests via peer whitelisting, and generalize the `Join()` utility for broader container compatibility.

**PR #6518** – Merged on April 1: Backports Bitcoin PRs #25430 and #25394 to explicitly save `MiniWallet` mode in tests and add `*_STANDARD` variables to the `depends` build system for improved configuration.

**PR #6524** – Merged on April 4: Backports Bitcoin PRs #25383, #25535, and #25337 to optimize wallet DB access, improve dust-related test reliability, and refactor address book handling by encapsulating wallet access.
